what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: In person at Town Hall; Zoom (https://us02web.zoom.us/j/9091740347?omn=86592718122, Meeting ID 909 174 0347, phone (888) 475-4499) offered as a courtesy; broadcast on Lunenburg Public Access, Facebook Live and YouTube.

items.agenda_line: • Acknowledgement of the Resignation of Jessica “Jak” Miller, Assistant Town Manager
items.why_it_matters: The board is to acknowledge the resignation of a senior town official, which bears on who staffs the Town Manager's office.

items.agenda_line: • Update on Food Pantry Relocation and License Agreement
items.why_it_matters: The board is to hear an update on moving the food pantry and on the license agreement for its new space, a service residents use.
The board is to finalize the warrant, consider Select Board sponsored articles, and review the postcard for the November 17 Special Town Meeting.

items.agenda_line: • Presentation of Special Town Meeting Articles:
items.why_it_matters: Covers the Brooks House report from the Director of Planning and Economic Development, a joint session with the Stormwater Task Force on an article, and School Department representatives on a Middle/High School track and field article.
The board is to discuss the town's municipal buildings; the agenda gives no further detail.

items.agenda_line: • Status of Polling Location for November 3, 2026 Election
items.why_it_matters: Residents voting in the November 3 election may need to know where the polling place will be.
The board is to approve the warrant for the upcoming election.

items.agenda_line: • All Liquor, On-premises Liquor License Application for Kiku, Inc. d/b/a Kiku Asian Cuisine Located at 50 Massachusetts Avenue
items.why_it_matters: A public hearing on an all-alcohol on-premises liquor license application for a restaurant at 50 Massachusetts Avenue.

items.agenda_line: • Change of Manager Application for Existing Liquor License for Global Montello Group Corporation d/b/a
items.why_it_matters: A public hearing on a change of manager for the existing liquor license at Honey Farms, 134 Leominster-Shirley Road.

items.agenda_line: • Acknowledgement of the Resignation of Autumn Buck, Heavy Equipment Operator
items.why_it_matters: The board is to acknowledge the resignation of a town heavy equipment operator.

preview.hook: Assistant Town Manager's resignation, food pantry license agreement, and the Special Town Meeting warrant
preview.one_line: Select Board, Oct 20, 7 PM: Assistant Town Manager resignation, food pantry license agreement, Special Town Meeting warrant; also Brooks House report, track and field, stormwater.
